Hi! I'm Maxine and I'm originally from Calgary, AB. I completed my BSc in Cognitive Systems and a Minor in Data Science at UBC. Before starting this program, I was a 2025 DSSG Fellow at the UBC Data Science Institute and  working as an HRIS Data Analyst at MNP. From the UBC MDS program, I am hoping to gain technical depth and a more holistic understanding of the field to become a Data Scientist.
